title: Excellent practice
content: The staff on the desk were brilliant, very helpful and informative all delivered with a pleasant smile and friendly chat, I was sincerely impressed. the doctor I saw was once again attentive and friendly and informative. I have no qualms about recommending this practice to anyone.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
